variants.name: 灵动环
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished standalone Windows desktop app icon for a Chinese network/proxy switching utility named 灵智 (Lingzhi), conveying flexibility and intelligence. Existing UI is charcoal and vivid blue. Square image, straight-on, centered single icon tile, generous transparent exterior around a rounded-square tile (tile fills about 86% of canvas). No text, no words, no letters unless specifically requested in the concept. Design must be recognizable at 32px: bold silhouette, simple geometry, crisp edges, few elements, high contrast. Sophisticated custom brand symbol. No watermark, no sheet, no multiple examples, no perspective mockup, no scenery. Actual transparent background outside tile. Concept A: An elegant continuous ribbon shaped as a fluid infinity loop, its two flowing arms subtly indicate two opposite network directions through tapered geometry, with a tiny clean diamond-shaped negative-space spark at their joining point for intelligent switching. Compact balanced silhouette, not overly wide. Electric cobalt blue and luminous aqua ribbon, rich midnight-navy rounded square tile. Restrained subtle dimensional shading, mostly clean vector-like graphic, no neon glow, no ornamental circuitry. Premium nimble utility identity.
